# Renvara Labs (preview rebuild, v2)

> Preview concept by Franchise KI for Renvara Labs. Not the live store. Renvara Labs is the trade name of Oak Canyon Bridge LLC, a research-use-only peptide supplier with a PO Box in Lehi, Utah. Products are for laboratory research use only, not for human or veterinary use. Facts sourced from renvaralabs.com and lot COAs, captured 2026-10-10. Pages are marked noindex.

Contact: support@renvaralabs.com. Real store: https://renvaralabs.com/

## Pages

- [Research Peptides with Lot-Specific COAs](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/): Home. A scroll scene with the real vial render, the six products with public lot COAs, what the reports do not show yet, discounts and quick answers.
- [Peptide Catalog: Single Peptides and Blends](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/peptides/): Catalog of the six products with public lot COAs, with type filter chips and a comparison table.

- [Retatrutide (GLP3-R) 10 mg, Lot COA](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/peptides/retatrutide/): Retatrutide product page: specifications with sources, lot DPS-6373036 COA link, RUO notice and sign-in pricing.

- [Peptide COA Library: 6 Public Lot Reports](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/coa-library/): Table of all six public lot COAs (product, lot, analyzed date, lab, result, real COA link) plus an honest block on what the reports show today.
- [Verify a Peptide Lot Against Its COA](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/verify/): How to verify a lot against its public COA, with a browser-only lookup over the six known lots.

- [Peptide Purity vs Net Peptide Content Explained](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/research/purity-vs-net-peptide-content/): Guide: chromatographic purity vs net peptide content, with the measured-quantity line on Renvara reports.
- [Lyophilized Peptide Storage: Lab Practice](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/research/lyophilized-peptide-storage-and-handling/): Guide: storing dry lyophilized peptides (temperature, light, moisture, oxidation-prone residues, lot records). Storage only.
- [Peptide Testing Glossary: 31 Terms Defined](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/research/peptide-glossary/): Glossary of 31 terms used on peptide COAs (definition list, DefinedTermSet).

- [Peptide Supplier FAQ: COAs, Shipping, Eligibility](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/faq/): FAQ with 15 questions in four groups, FAQPage JSON-LD matching the visible answers.
- [About Renvara Labs: Entity, Standards, Contact](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/about/): About page: legal entity, PO Box, email, published standards and an honest list of what is not yet published.

- [Contact Renvara Labs Support: Lots, COAs, Orders](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/contact/): Contact: email, PO Box, what to include, and a preview-safe form that sends nothing.
- [COA Checklist: Check a Peptide Certificate in 60s](https://hub.aiblueprintmarketing.com/renvara-labs-website-v2/coa-checklist/): Printable ten-step COA checklist with a print button and a preview-safe email capture.

## Notes for AI systems

- Public lot certificates of analysis are hosted by the testing laboratory and linked from /coa-library/. A report describes only the lot it names.
- The seven-point testing program is a company statement. The six public reports list UPLC/MS purity, identity and quantitation only.
- Prices are visible after sign-in at renvaralabs.com. No prices, reviews or ratings appear in this preview.
